subject: ddl: skip getting actual end key for each range in ingest mode (#54143)
summary: Adjusts backfill task generation so add-index ingest (LitMerge) mode no longer calls `GetRangeEndKey` per region range; keeps end-key shrinking for other backfill modes, and threads backfiller type into task creation while reusing a shared table-range splitting helper for operator-based scans.
